newsitem.title: JAPAN: Helicopter crash in western Japan kills eight.
newsitem.headline: Helicopter crash in western Japan kills eight.

text.p: Eight people were found dead in the wreckage of a company-owned helicopter that crashed into the mountains in western Japan, police officials said on Saturday.
The helicopter, which had been missing since Friday afternoon, was owned by Toyota Motor Corp and carried six Toyota employees and two crew members, including the pilot.
Rescuers found the aircraft and bodies in the mountains facing Mikawa Bay in Aichi Prefecture, about 250 km (155 miles) southwest of Tokyo, prefecture police said.
"We're terribly sorry that this happened," a Toyota official who arrived at the accident scene told reporters on Saturday.

The helicopter had left neighboring Shizuoka Prefecture on Friday on an hour-long flight to a company heliport in Toyoda City, Aichi Prefecture. Contact with the aircraft was lost about 10 minutes before its scheduled arrival, Toyota officials said.
Police said they do not know what caused the crash. The Transport Ministry sent five investigators to the accident site.
